_meta.repo_basis: wt-web @ c8faa34 — also the live production deployment
_meta.doctrine: Every value carries a tag. MEASURED = read in a cited file or fetched from a cited URL on a cited date. INFERRED = reasoned, carries low/base/high and a stated basis. DISPUTED = equally authoritative sources disagree; both positions kept.
_meta.two_models: AS_IS = what the code does today. AS_DESIGNED = the spec pack's intent with all six Margin Engine levers working. Both are computed at every step and never blended.
_meta.void: Every price in docs 01-12 and every margin percentage in PRD 7.2 is a pre-build placeholder computed against placeholder prices. Nothing here derives from them.

inr_per_usd.note: three independent sources agree in a 95.30-95.60 band

annual_depreciation_pct.note: spot cross-check +9.24%, RBI cross-check +9.02%; call it ~9%/yr

gemini-2.5-flash-image.note: per-image meter, not per-token; no lever touches it

routing.note: compile-time map, no ai_model_routes table, deploy-only

complexity_classifier.note: TASK_TIER is dead code; each task file's own def.tier wins

prompt_caching.note: cached prefix renders to 701 chars = ~175 tokens against minimums of 4096 (haiku) and 1024 (sonnet/opus); fails on all four cached tasks under either reading of the minimum

batch.note: vendors publish exactly -50% on both legs

cost_telemetry.note: cost_usd SELECTed by nothing; credit_ledger.cogs_usd_est null on every row

estimator_error.value: wrong and HIGH on 4 of 6 reachable models
estimator_error.note: haiku [1,5] correct, opus [5,25] correct, everything else [3,15]; sonnet actual [2,10], gpt-4o-mini actual [0.15,0.60], image model priced on the chat schedule entirely. Recorded COGS is a ceiling, never a floor.

actions._note: 6 of 18 priced actions have a charging code path. 11 are unreachable. inbox_reply and the free first brand resolve are reachable, cost real money and charge nothing. Verified twice.
actions._token_source: outputs are MEASURED observedMax from packages/mesh/src/token-budget.ts; inputs are INFERRED from rendering the real prompt strings at ~4 chars/token, since no prompt_tokens measurement exists for 6 of 8 tasks

loop_cycle.note: produces EXACTLY 5 briefs — PlanWeekOutputSchema.length(5) at packages/shared/src/mesh/tasks.ts:241. This is the backbone of the derived usage profile.

site_generate.note: output is a FLOOR not a measurement (token-budget.ts:81-82). Gated by entitlements to sites:0 on free, and nothing writes subscriptions, so it has NEVER executed in production.

image_standard.note: no lever touches this line — it is a per-image meter

brand_research.note: the ONE tier divergence: routing.ts:61 says economy, brand-guidelines.ts:39 says standard, and def.tier wins. The bake-off recorded haiku at equal specificity. First resolve per workspace is FREE and unbounded.

_uncharged_but_costing: brand_research first resolve (full sonnet call, creditsCharged 0, no ledger)
the publish platform write itself (no action key exists)
the onboarding PDF door (up to 4 billed calls + OCR page fee)

_mechanism.value: one retry on the SAME model, resending every original message plus the failed output plus ~40 tokens
_mechanism.note: so the repair's INPUT is larger than the original's. No retry loop, no backoff, no timeout anywhere in packages/mesh/src.

rate.basis: the only measurement is brand_extract going 5-in-6 before the 4096-token ceiling fix to 0-of-7 after (commit c8faa34 body). n=7 post-fix, one task only. No per-task production rate exists.

usage_profile._derivation: DERIVED FROM PRODUCT DEFAULTS, not invented. The Loop is weekly and plan_week returns exactly 5 briefs by schema. Everything else is a conversion rate off those 5 briefs.

loops_per_month.basis: 4.33 = one Loop per week, the product's designed cadence. Low = fortnightly, the realistic behaviour of a user who has to press the button manually because no scheduler runs.

briefs_per_loop.source: packages/shared/src/mesh/tasks.ts:241 .length(5) and the system prompt at plan-week.ts:52 'EXACTLY 5 briefs'

brief_to_variants_rate.basis: share of briefs a user actually turns into channel variants. No telemetry exists; 0.7 assumes most planned ideas get drafted.

variants_to_image_rate.basis: share of drafted posts that get a generated image. Images are the single largest COGS line so this rate matters more than any other behavioural assumption.

caption_rewrites_per_month.basis: an editing action; base assumes ~20% of drafted posts get one rewrite

site_generates_per_month.basis: a one-off action. Base assumes 1 in 20 workspaces generates a site in a given month. HAS NEVER EXECUTED IN PRODUCTION — the entitlement gate blocks it for every workspace because nothing writes subscriptions.

brand_research_per_signup.note: one per signup, and the FIRST one is free and uncharged

_billing_axis.value: per connected account, not per call
_billing_axis.source: docs/17_One_Week_Beta_Plan_SAHODA_LABS.md:63; corroborated docs/14_Launch_Plan_SAHODA_LABS.md:225 'Per-account cost makes 2 free channels a real cost line.'

usd_per_account_month.note: the same sentence says 'roughly ... at volume' and instructs asking Zernio what the cap counts and what the next tier costs. Treat as an order of magnitude. No rate card exists in the repo — grep for zernio x price|cost|usd|billing|plan returns only a rate-limit header.

S1_per_connected_account.note: the literal reading. Every channel a workspace connects bills every month whether or not it publishes.

S2_per_active_account.note: only accounts that actually transacted in the month count. Halves the free-tier carry.

S3_per_profile.note: the cap counts profiles/organisations, so a workspace is one billable unit regardless of how many channels hang off it. Makes channels free to grant and destroys channels as a cost fence.

channels_that_exist.note: the plan table sells 8 to Growth and Agency; only 4 exist

publish_flags_default_off.note: SAHODA_PUBLISH_MODE=fixture, DISPATCH_MODE=off, RECONCILE_MODE=off, PUBLISH_ENABLED unset. All publish-driven COGS is zero until every one is set. Runtime values unknown.

vercel_pro.note: 1 deploying seat, $20 usage credit that does not roll over; includes 1TB transfer + 10M edge requests and nothing else

supabase_pro.note: includes $10 compute credits; Team at $599 buys ZERO additional quota

supabase_compute_micro.note: covered by the $10 credit at this rung

clerk.source: production runs a Clerk DEVELOPMENT instance — pk_test_, leading-hyena-7.clerk.accounts.dev, verified on the live sign-in page
clerk.note: $25/mo Pro after a pk_live cutover; 50,000 MRU included so it stays flat to that cliff

sentry.note: Developer free tier suffices at this volume; Team is $26/mo annual-billed

resend.note: exactly one email exists in the codebase and it is an admin OTP. Zero customer-facing email.

upstash.note: 2 commands per call, 3 call sites; free tier is 500k commands/month

trigger_dev.source: apps/jobs/CLAUDE.md:10-13 'No deploy has ever been made from this repo'

cloudflare.note: no real deploy, no hosting cost

upi_mdr_pct.source: headline, EXCLUSIVE of GST — the vendor states this explicitly

upi_autopay_debit_inr_1000_plus.source: same — the threshold TRIPLES the per-debit fee and is a real pricing-design constant

refund_fee.note: not published on any fetchable Cashfree page; /pricing/ returns 403, /docs/help/payments/refunds 404s. Razorpay publishes Rs0 refund processing as a benchmark.

promo_0pct.a: 0% to 31 Mar 2027 up to Rs20L GMV per MONTH (cashfree.com/payment-gateway-charges/)
promo_0pct.note: per-month vs lifetime is a durable floor vs a one-time runway. EXCLUDES subscriptions and international entirely, so it does not touch either recurring revenue or the USD tier. Model on 1.95%.

what_is_wired.value: Cashfree only, INR-hardcoded, ONE-TIME orders, and the checkout bridge route does not exist
what_is_wired.note: no customer has ever been able to pay. Every revenue figure in this model is a forecast.

gst_pct.note: IT services were NOT moved in the Sep 2025 GST 2.0 rationalisation

inclusive_divisor.source: net = gross / 1.18. Subtracting 18% instead understates net revenue by 3.2% and compounds through every downstream line.

b2c_display_rule.note: must show the total in a single figure with the tax broken out. Legal Metrology MRP rules govern packaged GOODS, not services. CCPA has penalised showing a tax-inclusive price then adding GST at checkout.

export_zero_rated.source: Section 16 IGST Act, conditional on all five limbs of Section 2(6)
export_zero_rated.note: requires an annual LUT (Form GST RFD-11) and FIRC/e-BRC remittance evidence. A lapsed LUT retrospectively converts a zero-rated year into an 18% liability.

rcm_pct.source: Section 5(3) IGST Act, self-invoice under s.31(3)(f) within 30 days
rcm_pct.note: MUST be paid from the electronic CASH ledger — s.49(4) forbids using ITC for RCM. Creditable afterwards.

rcm_lockup_months.basis: 60-day statutory refund window under s.54(3) plus the practical filing cycle. Export-heavy revenue produces nil output GST, so the credit has nothing to offset and accumulates as a permanently outstanding receivable proportional to foreign vendor spend.

equalisation_levy.note: nothing is in force in FY2026-27

tds_on_saas.source: Engineering Analysis Centre of Excellence v CIT (SC, 2021) — off-the-shelf software is not royalty
tds_on_saas.note: budget CA fees for Form 146 on any vendor crossing Rs5 lakh/year (~USD 5,200)

dpdp_oneoff_inr.basis: itemised: legal review + consent notice + DPA templates, engineering for consent/erasure/retention/export, breach runbook. Obligations bite 14 May 2027 (PIB backgrounder, primary).

soc2.note: a US enterprise procurement artifact with no standing in Indian law and no DPDP relevance. An Indian SMB buyer asks for a GSTIN and a tax invoice.

framework.value: Digital Payments - E-mandate Framework, 2026, RBI/DPSS/2026-27/396, issued 21 April 2026

afa_free_ceiling_inr.source: s.8 verbatim: 'All recurring transactions may be authorised without AFA up to Rs15,000/- per transaction.'
afa_free_ceiling_inr.note: applies identically to cards, PPIs AND UPI. The common belief that UPI AutoPay carries a higher limit is WRONG under the 2026 framework.

enhanced_ceiling_categories.note: a closed, enumerated list. Software subscriptions do NOT qualify.

pre_debit_notice_hours.note: every renewal generates a proactive opt-out-bearing message 24 hours before payment — an involuntary-churn prompt that exists at Rs499 just as much as at Rs14,999

variable_mandate_cap.note: s.4(c) references an 'overall cap fixed by the RBI' for variable-amount mandates; the cap itself is not stated in the retrieved text. A second, separate constraint.

global_competitors_publishing_inr.source: nine tools checked: Ocoya, Predis, Blaze, Simplified, ContentStudio, SocialBee, FeedHive, Buffer, Later
global_competitors_publishing_inr.note: FeedHive prices in EUR; the other eight in USD. Predis is a Bengaluru company and still prices in dollars.

zoho_social_inr.note: ex-GST. Standard buys TWELVE channels for Rs900 — the hardest comparison in the market.

zocialone_inr.note: +18% GST at checkout; 3/10/25 social accounts; the closest INR-native AI-native comparable

buffer_free.value: 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts per channel, 1 user
buffer_free.note: the genuine entry point to the category and the thing any new product is actually priced against

usd29_landed_inr_b2b.source: arithmetic on measured inputs: $29 x Rs95.66 + 3.5% card markup + 18% GST on the markup
usd29_landed_inr_b2b.note: a GST-registered Indian business pays +4.13% over spot

usd29_landed_inr_b2c.source: same plus 18% OIDAR IGST charged by the foreign vendor, non-recoverable
usd29_landed_inr_b2c.note: an unregistered Indian consumer pays +22.87% over spot

later_raised_prices.value: Starter +12.5%, Growth +25% with a one-third cut to sets AND seats, free plan eliminated
later_raised_prices.note: the only dated before-and-after evidence obtained in the category

churn_cac._evidence_quality: India-specific SMB SaaS churn, CAC and free-to-paid conversion were NOT OBTAINED after six targeted searches across Chargebee, SaaSBoomi, Bessemer, Chiratae-Zinnov and Inc42. Every figure below is a GLOBAL benchmark and is labelled as such. Converting a US CAC into rupees would be a fabrication — the source set itself states comparable regions run 40-60% lower.

pure_freemium.note: weaker provenance; this is the band a no-card free tier actually lands in

india_involuntary_churn_driver.note: directional and India-specific, but no percentage exists. The 24-hour pre-debit opt-out notice is a structural churn surface at every price point.
